instruction: In refund.py, rewrite refund_amount using guard clauses: return 0.0 immediately when ticket is None, then return 0.0 immediately when the ticket is used, then handle the remaining cases with early returns so that no if statement is nested inside another if. notes: No rope refactoring inverts control flow.
